title: Earth's Future: Thematic Areas for a Growing Journal
content:
Abstract

We announce updates to the aims and scope of Earth's Future that introduce three Thematic Areas: Climate Impacts, Communities and Resilience, and Sustainable Resource Systems. These additions provide focal points for community building and editorial leadership within the journal's broad, transdisciplinary mission. We describe the motivation for these changes, outline each thematic area, and reaffirm that Earth's Future remains open to submissions across the full scope of Anthropocene science.
